resources.string: Shows the map automatically while a route is active. Requires root helper 1.2.7. The manual test buttons below run for 60 seconds. A manual test pauses automatic display until the route ends.
Shows the map on the cluster during navigation and restores the media card when the route ends or iPhone disconnects. Changing this setting requires reconnecting CarPlay.
Enable “%1$s” in this test card and reconnect CarPlay. Start navigation and try “Show CarPlay map” again. If it is already enabled, check the test report: iPhone has not started the map stream.
Changes map labels and icons independently of geographic zoom. Larger percentages make them bigger. Applies after reconnecting CarPlay.
Zoom in and out on the active cluster map without reconnecting. iPhone may adjust geographic zoom during navigation.
First open a map on the cluster and keep iPhone connected.
